prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 62.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Basics Overview Screen: Add a dedicated onboarding screen right before the final home screen that highlights desktop pet controls like hiding, summoning, and interacting. (why: Support receives multiple tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet once setup completes.)
1: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Account Sync Safety Notice: Update the sign in screen copy to explicitly reassure users that existing pets and progress will be securely linked and restored. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) is users losing or having pets reset after signing in.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Move the sign-in requirement to occur after selecting a pet and filling out the adoption certificate so users build attachment first. (why: Sign-in currently drops 23% of users early before they have seen or created their pet.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Guidelines Diagnostic Card: Add photo selection guidelines and quality indicators directly onto the photo upload screen. (why: Users emailed support saying custom pet creation failed or resulted in broken visual outputs.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Interactive Pet Path Choice Cards: Update the path selection screen layout to a two-column card view showcasing distinct path features. (why: Choose path has high mean completion time (514s), indicating hesitation while reading options.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pre-Made Pet Selector Carousel: Transform the friend selection screen into an interactive carousel with animated pet previews and personality tags. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate in the funnel with only 62.7% conversion.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Presence Troubleshooter Callout: Display a notification tip on the home intro screen detailing how to summon the pet if display issues occur. (why: Support received emails regarding pets not displaying on desktop or app refusing to open on first run.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Welcome Story Companion Preview Banner: Enrich the intro story screen with a centered layout and interactive pet mascot preview animation. (why: Improving initial engagement at the start of the flow reduces overall onboarding drop-offs.)
